text:
micah: quick heads-up: I'm kicking off a v2 preflight for /generate at 22:00 UTC. Canary in eu-west-1, plan is canary -> slow-shift -> staged full. tagging @nina @james for ops and replay. please be available for 22:00-23:00 UTC. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2-preflight-2026-03-21 by micah. Canary shard: eu-west-1. Initial weight: 5%. Auto-ramp disabled until operator resume.

nina: I'll cover ops. micah, supply the tenant pinlist and any gateway exceptions we need to apply.

micah: initial pinlist: tenant-314 (mobile sdk). withholding tenant-42 until we confirm header handling. Gateway exception: disable header-case-normalizer for tenant-314. Commands: `deploybot pin add tenant-314 --reason "mobile header compatibility"` and `deploybot toggle set header-normalizer off --tenants tenant-314`

james: doing a local replay against the canary image and seeing a small cluster of 502s from eu-edge in smoke:
```
[2026-03-21T21:57:55Z] request_id=xyz001 route=/generate status=502 backend=runtime-1 latency_ms=1160
[2026-03-21T21:57:56Z] request_id=xyz002 route=/generate status=502 backend=runtime-1 latency_ms=1198
```
Maybe related to recent kv-cache tuning or a kernel selection flag flip.

nina: let's be conservative. hold ramp at 10% and add auto-rollback: error_rate>2.0% (5m) OR p50>800ms (5m). Also narrow pins to tenant-314 only for now.

micah: ack. pausing ramp at 10% and removing tenant-42. Running: `deploybot pin remove tenant-42` now.

deploy-bot: Action: pin remove tenant-42 requested by micah. Status: succeeded. Canary paused at 10%. Active traffic weight: 10%. Auto-rollback rules set: error_rate>2.0% (5m), p50>800ms (5m). Alerts routed to #eng-oncall and #incidents. :warning:

elaine: I'll update the release notes: mention header-normalizer toggle for tenant-314, canary held at 10% due to eu-edge smoke. Ops runbook updated with rollback thresholds and escalations.

nina: after 10m of stable metrics we can move to 25%. if errors reappear we'll rollback fully and escalate to infra/research. deploy-bot, please post baseline metrics every 5m. :thumbsup:

micah: baseline (pre-roll): p50=220ms, error_rate=0.1%, p95=480ms. posting a telemetry snapshot in ~3m. handing off to on-call.

james: on replay I'll try toggling the new kernel selector flag off to see if 502s stop. prepping a hotfix branch just in case.

deploy-bot: Next manual step required to resume ramp: `deploybot resume --canary v2-preflight-2026-03-21 --by micah` or auto-resume if metrics stable for 10m.
